text: 你用训练有素的眼光检查这些物品。王冠和仪式长袍显然是真品，也符合你的预期。它们保存完好，肯定能卖个好价钱，但并不比其他古物稀有。哈里斯教授的日记似乎对学者有价值；你小心地翻了几页，发现其中不仅有历史相关信息，还有个人记录和旅行见闻。这很可能是了解哈里斯教授本人的重要资料。
不过，其他几件物品明显不同。祭坛和陶土圆筒刻有相似的文字，也有相近的陈旧磨损痕迹。因此，它们不太可能是伪造品，却和古印度较为传统的发现并不相同。仔细检查蜥蜴偶像后，你也认为它确实是真品。它的做工怪异而不自然，显然和你见过的古印度或其他地方的任何作品都不一样，但它同样没有现代工具加工的痕迹，也没有受到现代风格影响。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 45
text: You examine the items with a trained eye. The crown and ceremonial robe are obviously authentic and typical of what you would expect. They are in great condition and would certainly fetch a good price, though they are no rarer than any other antiquity. Likewise, Prof. Harris’ journal seems like it would be of value to a scholar, though a few delicate cursory page turns show that it contains personal accounts and travelogues as well as historically relevant information. This is likely a good source of information on Prof. Harris himself.

However, the other items present are noticeably different. The altar and clay cylinders bear a similar script, and both show comparable signs of aging and wear. Given this, they are unlikely to be fabrications, but they are unlike more traditional finds from ancient India. A close inspection of the lizard idol leads you to believe it is likewise verifiably authentic. Though the workmanship is strange and unnatural and clearly nothing like anything you’ve seen from ancient India or elsewhere, it doesn’t bear any signs of work from modern tools or influence from modern styles either.
